prompt: An illustration of a vast, luminous neural network rendered as a towering hospital-like structure of the mind: hundreds of small, distinct "expert" chambers — each labeled with a specialty such as mathematics, languages, history, code — arranged in stacked rows and mostly dim and dormant in cool grey. At the entrance, a glowing gatekeeper figure (the router) reads an incoming scroll of text and throws a handful of bright switches, causing only two or three chambers to light up in warm gold, sending their signals forward along a few lit pathways while the rest of the immense network stays dark. Beside the scene, a simple ledger graphic contrasts the full mountain of the network's total knowledge with the tiny lit fraction drawn upon at this moment, with a caption reading: "Trillions of parameters known; only a few consulted — the whole hospital's wisdom, but only the specialists you need."
